5. After hearing the learned counsel for parties and upon perusal of record this Court finds that charges have been framed against applicant by Court below.
Thereafter, the trial of applicant commenced.
Upto this stage, two prosecution witnesses have deposed before Court below.

6. In view of above, the prayer prayed for by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
has now been rendered infructuous.
It is by now well settled that once the charges have been framed against accused the same have to be assumed by Court concerned one way or the other.
As such, no effective relief can be granted by this Court in favour of applicant in present application.
7. In view of above, the present application fails and is liable to be dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
8. It is, accordingly, dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
